out_of_scope_observations.observation: _get_or_create_slot calls day['slots'].setdefault(slot_id, ...) with NO validation against day.schema.json's slot allow-list, so any client-supplied slot (e.g. meals-any, typos) silently writes a schema-forbidden key. This cycle guards client-side via SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS; a defense-in-depth server-side slot-key allow-list check would be more robust but is path-external to the user-stated un-gating need. Recorded for visibility; not fixed this cycle.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: User un-gates a meal slot in-session (drag away default + place new restaurant); on reload the slot re-gates and the new selection can be lost.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The two React-state writes that clear slots[X].skipped=false (react_template.tpl:2366, 2963) never emit a 'skip' mutation, so day-NN.json retains skipped:true, skipped_reason:'pre-arrival'. The front-end has zero 'skip' mutation emit sites despite the server handler and schema fully supporting it. Two correctness sub-causes surfaced by QA round 1: (a) MEAL_SLOTS (the candidate guard) includes the non-schema 'meals-any' pseudo-slot, so gating skip emits on it would write a forbidden slots['meals-any'] key to disk; (b) move handlers (Site C board branch, Site B origin) empty a SOURCE meal slot but only the TARGET was un-gated, leaving the source skipped:true on disk -> re-gates on reload.

pre_existing_guards.purpose: Existing UI meal-slot set. It INCLUDES the non-schema 'meals-any' pseudo-slot, so it is UNSAFE as a skip-emit guard. The React-state .skipped clears may keep using it, but skip emits MUST use the NEW SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS instead. Do NOT remove meals-any from MEAL_SLOTS (UI relies on it); ADD a separate SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS for emits.
Site A React-state un-gate guard (meal-only incl. meals-any). The React-state clear may keep this guard; the BACKEND skip emit must additionally pass SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS.has(srcSlotId).
Site B React-state un-gate guard (meal-only incl. meals-any). The React-state clear may keep this guard; the BACKEND skip emit must additionally pass SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS.has(targetSlotId).

_get_or_create_slot creates ANY slot_id with no schema validation. This is why the front-end SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS guard is load-bearing: a skip with slot:'meals-any' would write a schema-forbidden slots['meals-any'] key here. Do NOT weaken; do NOT rely on server to reject bad slot keys.
Defaults to skipped=True when extra omits it; the fix MUST pass extra.skipped=false explicitly to un-gate.

development_approach.strategy: Introduce a NEW const SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS = new Set(['breakfast','lunch','dinner']) adjacent to MEAL_SLOTS (2227) and a recommended shared helper buildSkipMuts(...ids) => [...new Set(ids)].filter(s=>s && SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS.has(s)).map(s=>({type:'skip',slot:s,extra:{skipped:false,skipped_reason:null}})) that centralizes the restricted guard + de-dup. At each meal-slot un-gate/selection site, PREPEND buildSkipMuts(...) to the existing saveMutations array. Site A (handleSidebarDrop 2406): buildSkipMuts(srcSlotId) -- source-only. Site B (applyBridge 2989): buildSkipMuts(targetSlotId, originSlotId-if-set-and-distinct) -- target + origin. Site C (Timeline drop 1915): board branch buildSkipMuts(payload.sourceSlotId, toSlotId) -- BOTH source and target (QA Defect 2 fix); candidates-applyBridge-absent fallback buildSkipMuts(toSlotId); setEditorSelection else-branch emit skip for toSlotId (separate saveMutations if not threadable into bridge). All emits gated by SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS (never MEAL_SLOTS) so meals-any/accommodation/activity never reach disk. No server/schema changes; no new gating logic for the codex-F2/QA-F4 stage-gate edge (documented as validation-time observation, out of scope).

findings.issue: F1: skip payload shape {type:'skip', slot, extra:{skipped,skipped_reason}} is exactly what _apply_skip_mutation consumes; use 'slot' not 'slot_id'

findings.rationale: Validation-time only (save.py does not run the stage gate); does not block AC3 persistence. Adding new stage-conditional gating is new logic = out of scope for this 'no new logic' cycle.
